prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The task, e.g. "Give your best 30-second sales pitch for a paperclip"

instructions.title: Extra instructions
instructions.description: Optional rules or hints shown under the prompt.

textLabel.title: Text field label
textLabel.description: Label of the short entry (title or one-liner) players type before performing.

timeLimit.title: Time limit (seconds)
timeLimit.description: Per player, from the moment they press Start.

points.title: Points for an approved entry
points.description: Awarded when the judge approves without entering a score. The host may instead score 0–10 points directly.
